reconstruction_choices.mechanism_limit: Pinned public Burke reduction, 10 species and 25 Cantera rate entries (22 unique equations); exact author mechanism file is unavailable. This is not exact author-data or author-weight replay.
reconstruction_choices.architecture: Canonical modified_MLP from the explicitly credited Wang base code, including unused hidden bias leaves; tanh, native JAX, equally partitioned 5x40 dot product, no extra output bias.
reconstruction_choices.time_coordinate: log(tau / 1 microsecond) + Shift(state). The time unit is a declared convention, not recovered author code. Shift outputs the additive log shift directly.
reconstruction_choices.split_limit: The 2023 text does not enumerate its training IC membership. Exclude its extrapolation phi .6/.7/1.3, and label its phi=1 plotted example as a seen training IC.
reconstruction_choices.normalization: Fifth root of all five representatives; min/max [-1,1] fitted only on training ICs.
reconstruction_choices.sampling: Uniform training trajectory, eligible start and positive stored future offset 1..200, with replacement. No log(0) floor, perturbations, or temporal resampling.
reconstruction_choices.initialization: Canonical Wang key split/Glorot normal; branch1234/trunk4321/shift5678. Exact Kumar seeds are unavailable.
reconstruction_choices.primary_weights: Literal last protocol weights. Best validation MSE weights are a separate diagnostic, frozen before test inference.
reconstruction_choices.primary_scope: Representative-five self-fed operator, matching the published H2 plots. No claim of full-nine-species reconstruction or exact conserved chemistry.
